Name: A Warm Welcome
Author: poaskkiliaks
Description:
Starting a new life in a strange town can be daunting, but not in Pelican Town! With "A Warm Welcome", you'll receive a personalized welcome from each villager, along with a small gift to help you get settled. Each villager's welcome message reflects their unique personality, adding a touch of charm and immersion to your early game experience. Robin might send you some wood to help you build a chest, while Abigail might leave you an amethyst for good luck in the mines. It's the little things that make a community feel like home. "A Warm Welcome" adds that extra layer of warmth and connection to your Stardew Valley journey.

[size=5]Installation Guide:

Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url].
Download "A Warm Welcome" and unzip it into your Mods folder.
Run the game using SMAPI.
